bRepDataModel.executionPath: CadGeometryKernel -> BRepKernel.getCanonical() -> createBox / createCylinder / createSphere / extrudeProfile
bRepDataModel.notes: Produces topological BRepSolid with outerShell, orientedFaces, loops, orientedEdges, and vertices.

topologicalEntities.executionPath: BRepVertex, BRepEdge, BRepLoop, BRepFace, BRepShell, BRepSolid, BRepCompound conforming to TopologyContracts.ts
topologicalEntities.evidence: Verified in Euler operator calculations V - E + F = 2

nurbsCurvesAndSurfaces.notes: Real Cox-de Boor mathematical evaluation, knot insertion, and surface derivatives up to 2nd order.

geometricTolerances.notes: Scale-aware tolerances conforming to IEEE-754 and CAD modeling domains.

geometricValidityAndClosure.executionPath: BRepValidator.validate(shape) -> checks manifoldness, orientation consistency, loop planarity, vertex coincidence
geometricValidityAndClosure.notes: Fail-closed validation rejecting open, non-manifold, or degenerate shapes.

booleanOperations.executionPath: BooleanEngine.execute(op, solidA, solidB) -> BooleanIntersector.intersectSolids -> BooleanSplitter -> BooleanAssembler
booleanOperations.notes: Genuinely executes Plane-Plane, Plane-Cylinder, and Plane-Sphere B-Rep Booleans. Returns UNSUPPORTED for Cylinder-Cylinder, Torus, Cone, or NURBS-NURBS pairs.

filletAndChamfer.executionPath: FeatureExecution -> FilletEngine.execute / ChamferEngine.execute -> rolling ball cylindrical face construction / planar bevel
filletAndChamfer.notes: Constructs real B-Rep blend faces and updates topology adjacencies.

shellAndOffset.executionPath: FeatureExecution -> ShellEvaluator.evaluate -> inward offset cavity creation
shellAndOffset.notes: Implemented for prismatic and box solids; generalized complex NURBS surface offsetting is missing.

directModeling.notes: Face translations with adjacent face re-trimming and mutation tracking.

transformations.executionPath: Affine 4x4 matrix multiplication applied to vertices, face origins, and normal vectors
transformations.evidence: Used across feature mirroring, patterning, and assembly mate transforms

massPropertiesAndBoundingBoxes.executionPath: Divergence theorem integration over B-Rep planar/curved faces for volume and AABB calculation
massPropertiesAndBoundingBoxes.notes: Computes exact volume, bounding box (AABB), and centroid.

sketchEngine.notes: Extracts 2D closed loops from line segments, arcs, and circles on planar coordinate systems.

constraintSolver.notes: Solves distance, coincident, parallel, perpendicular, and horizontal/vertical constraints.

degreesOfFreedom.executionPath: Tracks free vertices vs constrained degrees of freedom in 2D sketch space
degreesOfFreedom.evidence: Tested in sketch constraint qualification batteries
degreesOfFreedom.notes: Reports under-constrained, fully-constrained, and over-constrained states.

featureTreeAndDAG.notes: Maintains feature DAG, prevents cycles, and orders execution deterministically.

featureRegeneration.executionPath: FeatureHistory.regenerateAll -> walks topological order -> dispatches FeatureExecutor.execute
featureRegeneration.notes: Evaluates features in dependency order, propagating intermediate B-Rep solids.

recomputeOrderingAndFailurePropagation.executionPath: Modifying upstream feature marks all downstream dependents DIRTY; aborts on invalid inputs with fail-closed diagnostics
recomputeOrderingAndFailurePropagation.notes: Failure propagation halts evaluation and returns diagnostic error codes.

deterministicRegeneration.executionPath: Computes SHA-256 over canonicalized feature definitions and topological execution sequence
deterministicRegeneration.notes: Bit-exact identical hash outputs across repeated regenerations.

parameterManagement.executionPath: Iterative dependency expression resolver evaluating algebraic equations into numbers
parameterManagement.notes: Resolves parameter expressions and maps them to sketch dimensions and feature parameters.

geometryHashing.notes: Canonical SHA-256 hashing of vertex coordinates, edge curves, face surfaces, and bounding boxes.

topologyIdentityAndPersistentNaming.executionPath: Generates persistent tags (e.g. F_EXT_01_CapEnd) and semantic descriptors (normal, centroid, adjacency)
topologyIdentityAndPersistentNaming.notes: Faces and edges rebind successfully across legitimate geometry modifications.

shapeEquivalenceAndDeviation.executionPath: Compares topological counts and calculates Hausdorff distance between mesh tessellations
shapeEquivalenceAndDeviation.notes: Verifies geometric equivalence within scale-aware tolerance.

stepImportExport.notes: ISO 10303-21 / AP242 syntax parsing, header validation, entity cross-referencing, and round-trip verification.

technicalDrawingsAndProjections.executionPath: ProjectionEngine.projectSolid -> orthographic front/top/right and isometric projection with hidden line classification
technicalDrawingsAndProjections.notes: Converts 3D B-Rep edges into 2D drawing projection lines (VISIBLE / HIDDEN).

dimensionsAndGdt.notes: ASME Y14.5 / ISO 1101 datum reference frames, position, flatness, perpendicularity, runout.

billOfMaterials.executionPath: AssemblyBOMEngine.generateBOM(assemblyGraph) -> itemizes components, quantities, occurrence paths, and mass
billOfMaterials.evidence: Tested in assembly qualification test suites
billOfMaterials.notes: Indented and flattened BOM generation bound to assembly graph occurrence identities.
